_redirects_basis.net/minecraft/client/Minecraft.destroy(): 26.1.2 destroy: log, narrator.destroy, leave the level, screen.removed, close(); finally Util.timeSource = System::nanoTime and System.exit(0) unless hasDelayedCrash. 26.2 exitWorldAndClose: the same without the narrator (26.2's close() destroys it) and without the ending (26.2's Main shuts down after it; 26.2 has no delayed crash, its crash path exits at once). net/minecraft/client/Minecraft.destroy().basis: javap: 26.2's exitWorldAndClose is 26.1.2's destroy without the narrator.destroy call (moved into close()) and the time-source / System.exit ending (moved to Main); the rest (Stopping!, level.disconnect, disconnectWithProgressScreen, screen.removed, close) is the same in the same order, the screen read through gui.screen(). 26.2's Main calls it where 26.1.2's called destroy, at shutdown; anchors on the moved calls do not follow
